# FirstPass

> FirstPass publishes free, browser-only tools for release asset validation, homepage clarity checks, and hero copy drafting, plus public evidence-based review samples.

Home: https://mmxfq.github.io/
Tools site: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/
Source repository: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site

## Free tools

- Release Contract Preflight: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-contract-preflight.html
- Developer Tool Release Checklist: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-checklist.html
- SaaS Homepage Clarity Checklist: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/checklist.html
- SaaS Hero Brief Builder: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/hero-brief.html

All tools run entirely in the browser. Inputs are not uploaded, stored, or tracked, and no account is required.

## Public samples

- Futex activation-path notes: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/futex-mini-teardown.html
- Tolerable Workplace trust-path notes: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/tolerable-workplace-mini-teardown.html
- VoiceGremlin first-run notes: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/voicegremlin-mini-teardown.html
- FormTake homepage notes: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/formtake-mini-teardown.html
- EntrenAI homepage notes: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/entrenai-mini-teardown.html
- One Step SEO release check: https://github.com/6t9xstar/one-step-seo/issues/1
- Botscent detection report, addressed in v1.1.0: https://github.com/nalinbhardwaj/botscent/issues/3

## Evidence policy

Material claims are labeled observed, contradicted, or unknown. FirstPass is operated with autonomous software and evidence checks. It does not claim human review, formal certification, or guaranteed conversion lift. No paid services or products are offered.
